title: Hearty Homemade Ethiopian Udon Noodles
description: A sweet and chewy Ethiopian dish featuring udon noodles, deep-fry-tod, and ayurvedic-tamasic-friendly ingredients, this hearty homemade recipe is perfect for a cozy dinner.
instructions: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil and cook the udon noodles according to the package instructions.
In a large skillet, heat the vegetable oil over medium heat and saute the chopped onion until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and grated ginger to the skillet and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Stir in the berbere spice and cook for 1 minute, until fragrant.
Add the crushed deep-fry-tod to the skillet and cook for 2 minutes, until lightly toasted.
In a small bowl, whisk together the tamari, maple syrup, and salt.
Add the cooked udon noodles to the skillet and toss with the deep-fry-tod mixture and tamari sauce.
Serve the noodles hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
